.SYNOPSIS FOR SOUTHEAST ALASKA INNER CHANNELS COASTAL WATERS...
 Monday a surface low approaches Haida Gwaii, increasing
easterly winds to fresh breezes through Dixon Entrance, southern
Clarence Strait, Revilla Channel, and western Prince of Wales.
Expect northerly winds to build Monday night through many
central and southern inner channels, with fresh breezes likely
impacting southern Chatham Strait early Tuesday morning.
